How to get it :
- [[Ore Acidizer|Ore Acidizer]] : Trixite, 500 mB sulfuric acid.

Used to make :
[[Plutonium|Plutonium Powder]], [[gv:powder_cobalt|Cobalt Powder]], [[gv:powder_niobium|Niobium Powder]], [[gv:powder_nitan_mix|Nitanium Blend]], [[Plutonium|Plutonium Ingot]], [[gv:powder_spark_mix|Spark Blend]].
